'''Lana Dobreed''' was a [[human]] who lived during the final [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EV">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> they were in [[Mos Espa]], a [[spaceport]] settlement located on the [[desert]] [[planet]] of [[Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM" /> Dobreed served as a [[podracer]] [[Technician|mechanic]] and wore [[Color|dark-colored]] [[welding goggles]].<ref name="TCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref>
